{{Quote|We have to destroy the Black Sun fighters that have stationed themselves at each before we go for for the Darkveil Eclipse, the main hub.|[[Dartas Pytin]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:AtT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|After the Trinity|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
The '''Darkveil Eclipse''' was a space station in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Located in the [[Scarlet Dawn]] quadrant, it was the center of all [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] operations in the system. Along with the [[Dual Moons]], the Darkveil Eclipse formed the [[Salient Trinity]], the three Black Sun [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] bases in the system.<ref name="SWG:DE" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Darkveil Eclipse starfighters were led by [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Rilis]]. During the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]], the Darkveil Eclipse was attacked by [[Dartas Pytin]]'s [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] starfighters. Most of the Black Sun forces were eliminated, including Rilis, ending the Black Sun/Car'das conflict.<ref name="SWG:DE" />
